tasks.label: examples
tasks.detail: Stop any running example server, build the wasm (--dev), serve the example suite at http://127.0.0.1:5200, and open it

statusbar.label: $(play) Examples
statusbar.detail: Build and serve npm/examples, then open it in the browser

tasks.label: examples: stop
tasks.detail: Stop whatever serves the example suite at http://127.0.0.1:5200
args: $ids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5200 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($id in $ids) { taskkill /PID $id /T /F | Out-Null }; if ($ids) { 'Stopped the example server.' } else { 'No example server was running.' }
pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:5200 -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids && echo 'Stopped the example server.'; else echo 'No example server was running.'; fi
pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:5200 -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids && echo 'Stopped the example server.'; else echo 'No example server was running.'; fi
